zh.title: 關於我
zh.intro: 具備新媒體藝術碩士背景，專注於互動應用開發、全端網頁與多媒體設計。

zh.p1: 許哲誠，24歲，畢業於國立臺灣藝術大學新媒體藝術碩士班。主修 VR/AR 互動應用開發、全端網頁架構與多媒體美學設計。具備創新思維、跨領域溝通協調與專案企劃能力，擅長自我管理，對新技術與挑戰充滿熱忱。

en.title: About Me
en.intro: Holding an M.A. in New Media Art, focusing on interactive application development, fullstack web engineering, and multimedia design.
en.heading: Core Competency & Specialization
en.p1: Che-Cheng Hsu, 24 years old, graduated with an M.A. in New Media Art from National Taiwan University of Arts. Majoring in VR/AR interactive application development, fullstack web engineering, and multimedia design. Possesses innovative thinking, cross-domain communication skills, project planning expertise, self-management, and a passion for new technology challenges.
